articles.title: Russia's elections had few surprises - but how the Kremlin uses the results will be crucial
articles.description: Vladimir Putin will likely use the result to claim most Russians back the so-called special military operation in Ukraine, writes the BBC's Steve Rosenberg.

articles.title: US strikes on alleged drug boats could be crimes against humanity, says UN
articles.description: A report says the attacks, of which there have been at least 68, were not self-defence.

articles.title: Under-pressure German leader says state election result a 'disaster'
articles.description: Under-pressure German ‌Chancellor Friedrich Merz has described a state election result as a "disaster" but vowed to stay in office.

articles.title: Iran issues warning after 'learning US plans to resume action'
articles.description: Iran has issued a warning after reportedly learning that the US is planning to resume military action – after also insisting the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until its conditions are met.
